summary: The registrant filed a Form 6-K attaching the English translation of a payment notice for its Fixed Rate Series XXII Notes. The notice announces the third interest installment payment due July 23, 2026, on USD 15,799,810 principal outstanding, at a 5.75% annual rate, paying USD 450,511.02 in interest. The filing is a routine debt servicing communication and does not involve any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or restructuring. It is merely a scheduled interest payment notification.
